provenance.interproscan: InterProScan 5.78-109.0, 17 analyses (Pfam 38.2, PANTHER 19.0, CDD 3.21, Gene3D, SUPERFAMILY, SMART, ProSite, PRINTS, NCBIfam, PIRSF/PIRSR, Hamap, SFLD, AntiFam, Coils, MobiDBLite)
provenance.counting_unit: longest protein per gene (reference arm); one transcript per gene (Helixer arm)
provenance.genomes: 48 MaizeGDB REFERENCE assemblies (NAM founders, HiLo, Pan-Andropogoneae) + 6 outgroup species from Ensembl Plants release 63

curation_notes: TF: NAC excludes IPR002715 (Nascent polypeptide-associated complex NAC domain), a lexical false friend unrelated to NAC transcription factors.

Protein kinase (catalytic) excludes metabolic kinases (phosphofructokinase, riboflavin/histidine/pyrimidine/shikimate/adenylate/pyruvate kinase) and all phosphatases, which the bare word 'kinase' otherwise captures.

DNA replication EXCLUDES reverse transcriptase (IPR013103, IPR053134), viral/mitochondrial-plasmid polymerases, and bacterial-only DNA polymerase III/DnaG. Before this exclusion the class showed a spurious 4.3x outlier (one genome at 795 vs a mean of 185) driven entirely by retrotransposon reverse-transcriptase content, not replication machinery.
Helicase EXCLUDES Helitron, transposon, retroelement, viral and UvrD-like helicases for the same reason; three HiLo genomes were inflated to 573-801 versus a ~280 baseline before the fix.
TF: C2H2 zinc finger is deliberately inclusive and contains some spliceosomal/non-TF C2H2 proteins (e.g. Matrin/U1-C); treat its absolute count as an upper bound.
Immunity classes here are the browsable/inclusive view. Exclusive architecture-precedence NLR/RLK/RLP/PR calls live in maize_immunity_classes.json.
note: Classes are NON-EXCLUSIVE by design: a wall-associated receptor kinase carries both an LRR and a kinase domain and appears in both. This is intentional for a browsable resource. Exclusive assignment is handled by maize_immunity_classes.json, which uses architecture precedence.
